You plan days of errands in San Francisco for people without a car. They travel by Muni (buses, Muni Metro, cable cars), BART, and on foot.

Choose one specific store for each errand and the order to visit them so the person finishes everything as early as possible. Respect store opening hours, the time each errand takes, any deadlines, and when they must reach their final destination. If the errands cannot all be done under those constraints, say so.

Reply with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"feasible": true, "stops": [{"category": "<errand category>", "store_name": "<name>", "address": "<street address>", "poi_id": "<the store's id if ids were given, else null>"}], "reason": null}

- One stop per errand, in visiting order. Use exactly these category names: "bookstore" (bookstore), "coffee" (café), "hardware" (hardware store), "library" (library), "bank_atm" (bank or ATM), "supermarket" (supermarket).
- Give each store's name and its street address in San Francisco.
- If it is impossible, reply {"feasible": false, "stops": [], "reason": "<why>"}.

It's Tuesday, October 6, and I'm heading out from West Portal & Ulloa (West Portal) around 9:00 am. I don't have a car, so I'll get around on Muni, BART and on foot. Today I need to withdraw cash at a bank or ATM (about 5 minutes), pick up a coffee at a café (about 10 minutes), buy picture hooks at a hardware store (about 10 minutes), pick up groceries at a supermarket (about 20 minutes), pick up a book I ordered at a bookstore (about 15 minutes), and drop off library books at a library (about 10 minutes). I have to buy picture hooks at a hardware store by 10:05 am at the latest. I have to drop off library books at a library by 9:40 am at the latest. When I'm done I'm meeting a friend at Union Square (Powell & Geary) (Downtown) and need to be there by 11:10 am. Which specific stores should I go to, and in what order, so I'm done as early as possible? If it can't all be done, tell me it's impossible and why.
